description: This source file defines the ErrorResponse class used for handling error responses within the Fineract testing framework. It includes nested classes for representing individual errors and their message arguments, along with methods for parsing error responses from HTTP retrofit responses.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Represents an error response with a list of errors, HTTP status code, and developer message. Includes methods for extracting a single error and creating an instance from a retrofit response.

classes.name: ErrorResponse.Error
classes.description: Captures individual error details, including developer message and message arguments.

classes.name: ErrorResponse.ErrorMessageArg
classes.description: Represents arguments for error messages, encapsulating a value.

methods.name: getSingleError
methods.description: Returns the sole Error object if exactly one error exists; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an ErrorResponse instance by parsing the error body from a retrofit HTTP response.
